title: ALTER DATABASE SET options in SQL database

content.text: ALTER DATABASE SET options in SQL database are now available as a preview feature. For more information, see ALTER DATABASE SET options (Transact-SQL) for SQL database in Fabric. Collation support and full-text indexing are also now available in SQL database as preview features.
